about: Registration items from REF-0020 'Before real trading through a broker partner'. Live trading stays refused until every item is done with evidence, this file is committed and the site is redeployed. See the REF 'Going live with real trading'.

items.item: Broker partner picked (Alpaca Broker API) and its agreement signed
Lawyer's opinion that Parity's role and pay stay outside broker-dealer registration
Partner reviewed all trading screens and messages under FINRA Rules 2210 and 2214
Disclosures name the broker, SIPC, BrokerCheck and say Parity is not the broker
Customer data protection for data passed to and from the partner (GLBA, Safeguards Rule)
Complaint handling and record keeping as the partner contract requires
Crypto: the partner is the licensed party; Parity never holds coins or money
/legal/regulatory/ names the partner and its regulators
A reviewed migration allows mode = 'live' rows in the broker tables
